posts.title: Looking Back in Time!
posts.description: Springfield Republican Oct. 1, 1926 On Friday, Oct. 1, 1926, there was an interesting article in the Springfield Republican . The "Memories" are from 1901! This date marked the 25th anniversary of Dr. Henry Lincoln Bailey and his wife Nelle coming to Longmeadow. In 1901 they had arrived in town, because Dr. Bailey was the new Minister of First Church. posts.title: The Town of Longmeadow Splits
posts.description: Springfield Republican May 23, 1894 On July 1, 1894 the West Village and the East Village of Longmeadow, MA separated into 2 towns- Longmeadow and East Longmeadow. Once again, in early 1894 a petition had been sent to the State Legislature for the division. It passed. Massachusetts Gov. Frederic T.
